title: Attention Knows Whom to Trust: Attention-based Trust Management for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.target: General bias (emotional, ideological, cultural, and stereotypical)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating messages for bias violations (lack of objectivity, favoritism, or prejudice) using an attention-based logistic regression classifier (A-Trust) trained on attention patterns of an LLM processing samples from the StereoSet dataset. This is also compared against perplexity scores and LLM-as-a-judge prompting evaluating 'Neutrality & Bias'.
